### God-Given Foes and God-Given Faith
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/solid-joys/god-given-foes-and-god-given-faith
Passage: Philippians 1:27-29
Points:
- Living in a manner worthy of the gospel includes facing adversaries without fear.
- Paul reveals that believers receive two distinct divine gifts: faith and suffering for Christ.
- Believers do not need to be afraid because God sovereignly governs their opponents.
- The faith and courage needed in the face of hostility are also given by God.
- Christ’s sacrificial work secures God’s sovereign power to work all circumstances for our eternal good.

### A Sign of Destruction and Salvation
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/a-sign-of-destruction-and-salvation
Passage: Philippians 1:28
Points:
- Early Philippian Christians faced severe civic pressure to confess Caesar as lord rather than Jesus.
- A united church community contending together removes fear in the face of opposition.
- Worldly opposition to the church serves as an indicator of the persecutors' ultimate ruin.
- Patiently enduring hostility for Christ's name provides reassuring evidence of authentic salvation.
- Believers should ask God not for an easy escape from trials, but for grace to endure them faithfully.
